additional_info.subject: RE: ID0438416-DC/Si-D/AE- [ MP/R8 170002523] Display Damaged CRM:02684000406
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Ensure the DP cable is securely connected. If needed, try replacing it with a new one.
If replacing the DP cable does not resolve the issue:
Verify if the dLogic is receiving 24V.
If it is receiving power, please attempt a firmware update on the dLogic.
If it is not receiving power, proceed with replacing the HMI.
Please update the ticket once the checks are completed.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0438416 ﻿from the
